paragraphs: JAGGAER sells procurement software that carries an organization from sourcing a supplier through contracts, invoicing and payment. It aims at complex buyers, and names manufacturing, public sector and higher education among the industries it is built for.

The unified product is JAGGAER One, which brings source to pay and procure to pay into a single system. Public sector workflows called out include cooperative purchasing and contract vehicles. Grant-funded and project-based procurement is listed as another. Integration runs through pre-built connectors to SAP, Oracle, Workday, Infor, NetSuite and other business applications. An embedded AI assistant is governed by stated rules, among them that customer data is never used to train foundation or derivative models. Data is stored and processed only within selected regions. The AI framework claims alignment with ISO 42001 compliance standards.

The company states that over 1,300 enterprises worldwide use it to manage $2.9 trillion in annual spend. A customer panel names the State University of New York among higher education users. Another names the University of Virginia. That panel reports invoice processing reduced from hours to about one minute.

quote.text: JAGGAER One covers every spend category and every process stage.
